speaker: Doctor
text: I understand you have fatigue, flank pain, and fever following recent antibiotic treatment for acute sinusitis. To begin my assessment, please tell me if you have noticed any changes in your urination, such as frequency, urgency, blood, or a burning sensation.

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Pyelonephritis. The combination of fever, flank pain, and fatigue following a recent upper respiratory infection strongly suggests an ascending urinary tract infection that has progressed to the kidneys. Given the severity of these symptoms, I am requesting a Urinalysis and Urine Culture immediately to confirm the presence of bacteria and identify the specific organism. REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis, Urine_Culture.
